es: Sustituir expresiones vagas, redundantes o rebuscadas por palabras precisas del registro adecuado, y elegir entre voz activa y pasiva por estilo.

teaching.en: We will investigate the complaint and respond by Friday; between colleagues you would say we will look into it and get back to you.
teaching.es: Investigaremos la queja y responderemos antes del viernes; entre compañeros dirías que la vamos a revisar y te diremos algo.
teaching.explanationEs: Investigate y respond son verbos latinos y suenan formales; look into y get back to son phrasal verbs, más cercanos.
segments: We will investigate the complaint and respond by Friday; between colleagues you
would say we will look into it and get back to you.
teaching.audioText: We will investigate the complaint and respond by Friday; between colleagues you would say we will look into it and get back to you.

teaching.en: Guests may purchase drinks at the bar, whereas at home you would just say you can buy them, which sounds far more natural.
teaching.es: Los invitados pueden adquirir bebidas en la barra, mientras que en casa dirías simplemente que puedes comprarlas, lo que suena mucho más natural.
teaching.explanationEs: Purchase es la versión formal de buy; se ve en avisos y mensajes de empresa.
segments: Guests may purchase drinks at the bar, whereas at home you would
just say you can buy them, which sounds far more natural.
teaching.audioText: Guests may purchase drinks at the bar, whereas at home you would just say you can buy them, which sounds far more natural.

teaching.en: If you need assistance, please contact our team; between friends we would simply ask whether you need any help.
teaching.es: Si necesita asistencia, póngase en contacto con nuestro equipo; entre amigos preguntaríamos sin más si necesitas ayuda.
teaching.explanationEs: Assistance es más formal que help. Elige según el lector, no según lo elegante que suene.
segments: If you need assistance, please contact our team; between friends
we would simply ask whether you need any help.
teaching.audioText: If you need assistance, please contact our team; between friends we would simply ask whether you need any help.

teaching.en: We will rectify the fault, commence the repairs on Monday and make up for the delay with a discount on your next order.
teaching.es: Subsanaremos el fallo, comenzaremos las reparaciones el lunes y compensaremos el retraso con un descuento en su próximo pedido.
teaching.explanationEs: Rectify, commence y make up for tienen equivalentes cotidianos: fix, start y compensate o put right.
segments: We will rectify the fault, commence the repairs on Monday and make
up for the delay with a discount on your next order.
teaching.audioText: We will rectify the fault, commence the repairs on Monday and make up for the delay with a discount on your next order.

teaching.en: To ascertain the facts, we will carry out a short survey, which in plain English means finding out what really happened.
teaching.es: Para determinar los hechos realizaremos una breve encuesta, lo que en un inglés sencillo significa averiguar qué ocurrió realmente.
teaching.explanationEs: Ascertain es el verbo formal de find out; carry out significa llevar a cabo una acción.
segments: To ascertain the facts, we will carry out a short survey,
which in plain English means finding out what really happened.
teaching.audioText: To ascertain the facts, we will carry out a short survey, which in plain English means finding out what really happened.

teaching.en: «Return back» is redundant, so delete back; and the passive «your refund has been approved» sounds official because it hides who approved it.
teaching.es: «Return back» es redundante, así que elimina back; y la pasiva «su reembolso ha sido aprobado» suena oficial porque no dice quién lo aprobó.
teaching.explanationEs: Redundante: back no añade nada. La pasiva centra la frase en lo ocurrido; la activa («We approved it») es más cálida.
segments: «Return back» is redundant, so delete back; and the passive «your refund
has been approved» sounds official because it hides who approved it.
teaching.audioText: «Return back» is redundant, so delete back; and the passive «your refund has been approved» sounds official because it hides who approved it.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta más formal de la empresa al cliente.

choices.text: We will look into it and get back to you in a couple of days.
We will sort it out and come back to you as soon as we can.
We will investigate the matter and respond within two working days.

feedback.es: Investigate y respond son los verbos latinos: dan la versión más formal; las otras usan phrasal verbs y un tono más cercano.

hint.es: Los verbos de origen latino suenan más formales que los phrasal verbs.

origin.text: A customer writes: «My oven arrived broken, nobody answered my calls, and I have lost a whole week of cooking.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Las entradas se adquieren en taquilla, pero en línea salen más baratas.»

feedback.es: Purchased es el participio de purchase, la forma formal de comprar en avisos de empresa.

hint.es: Es el participio del verbo formal que equivale a buy.

origin.text: Tickets may be ___ at the desk, but it is cheaper to buy them online.

prompt.es: Elige la versión que elimina todas las palabras de sobra.

choices.text: We will meet at nine to discuss the planning.
We will all meet together at nine to discuss planning.
We will meet at nine to discuss the advance plans.

feedback.es: Meet ya implica encontrarse (together sobra) y advance repite lo que planning ya expresa; solo la primera quita ambas redundancias.

hint.es: Meet ya significa encontrarse y planning ya se hace antes.

origin.text: Draft: We will all meet together at nine to discuss the advance planning.

prompt.es: ¿Qué expresión repite información que el verbo ya contiene?

choices.text: review the rules
return back
before the audit begins

feedback.es: Return ya significa devolver o volver, así que back es redundante.

origin.text: The committee will return back the documents to the clients before the audit begins, and then it will review the rules.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada verbo formal con su significado.

feedback.es: Los cuatro verbos describen acciones de una empresa: corregir, empezar, ejecutar y compensar.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurrirá hoy con el dinero de la cliente.

choices.text: The request will be reviewed again.
The form will be sent back for corrections.
The money will be returned to the customer.

feedback.es: Approved y refund indican que la solicitud se acepta y que el dinero se devuelve hoy.

origin.audio: Your request has been approved, and the refund will be sent today. If you need any assistance in the meantime, please contact our team. We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿por qué usa la empresa «Your refund request has been approved» en pasiva?

choices.text: To sound official without saying who decided.
To hide the fact that the refund was refused.
To stress that the customer approved it.

feedback.es: La pasiva centra la frase en lo ocurrido (la solicitud aprobada) y no nombra a quien lo decidió, lo que da un tono oficial.

origin.text: Dear Mr Lopez, we have investigated your complaint and ascertained that the delivery was delayed by a fault at our store. We will rectify the situation by sending a replacement oven on Monday, and we will make up for the delay with a discount on your next purchase. Your refund request has been approved. If you need any further assistance, please reply to this message and a member of our team will respond within two working days. Kind regards, Customer Care

prompt.es: Elige la versión cotidiana de «we will rectify the situation».

choices.text: we will make the situation rectified
we will put things right
we will investigate the situation

feedback.es: Put right es el phrasal verb cotidiano de rectify; las otras opciones cambian el verbo o lo vuelven torpe.

origin.text: Dear Mr Lopez, we have investigated your complaint and ascertained that the delivery was delayed by a fault at our store. We will rectify the situation by sending a replacement oven on Monday, and we will make up for the delay with a discount on your next purchase. Your refund request has been approved. If you need any further assistance, please reply to this message and a member of our team will respond within two working days. Kind regards, Customer Care

prompt.es: Completa: «Nos disculpamos por el retraso y lo compensaremos con un descuento.»

feedback.es: Make up for es compensar una falta con algo a cambio; make va antes de up.

origin.text: We apologise for the delay and will ___ up for it with a discount on your next order.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Responderemos a su mensaje antes del viernes.»

answer.text: We will respond to your message by Friday
accepted: We will respond to your message by Friday
We will respond by Friday to your message

feedback.es: Respond se construye con to, y el plazo se marca con by + día.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pretende mostrar la hablante con los dos ejemplos.

choices.text: That companies should never use everyday verbs.
That friends never make official promises.
That the same promise can be worded for different readers.

feedback.es: Da la misma promesa con dos formulaciones, cercana y formal: la elección depende del lector, no hay reglas absolutas.

origin.audio: Honestly, I'll look into it and get back to you tomorrow; no need to make it official. If a company wrote to a client, they'd say they will investigate the matter and respond by tomorrow. Same promise, different wording.

prompt.es: ¿Qué efecto tiene la pasiva frente a «We have postponed the meeting»?

choices.text: It announces the change without saying who decided.
It makes the speaker take responsibility for the change.
It shows the meeting will now take place sooner.

feedback.es: «Has been postponed» centra la frase en lo ocurrido y no nombra al responsable; la activa sí lo haría asumir.

origin.text: Notice on the door: The meeting has been postponed until further notice. We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

prompt.es: Completa: «Una técnica llevará a cabo mañana una inspección completa.»

feedback.es: Carry out es llevar a cabo; el verbo carry va antes de out.

origin.text: The leak is serious, so a technician will ___ out a full inspection tomorrow morning.
